required_outcomes: Finds the tenant's reply offering Wednesday 14 October after 13:00 for the gas check.
Books HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe) for Wednesday 14 October after 13:00, before expiry.
Confirms the booking to the tenant in writing.
acceptable_alternatives: Also logging the broken blind as a separate routine job or noting the communal light for block management.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the gas check and the routine items separate.
red_flags: Treats the tenant as unresponsive and escalates or plans a hand-delivered letter.
prohibited_actions: Booking a slot the tenant did not offer without asking.
critical_failures: Leaving the check unbooked so the record lapses.
